name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun Verma's journey in motorsport began not on the track, but in the engineering labs of IIT Delhi. Armed with a degree in mechanical engineering, he initially gravitated towards Formula Student, where his innovative suspension designs caught the attention of a small IndyCar team. He quickly transitioned into a junior engineering role, soaking up knowledge and proving his mettle in data analysis and race strategy. His sharp mind and ability to make quick, informed decisions under pressure saw him rise through the ranks. 

Arjun's management style is characterized by a collaborative yet decisive approach. He believes in empowering his team to take ownership while providing clear guidance and support. A data-driven decision-maker, he is not afraid to take calculated risks. His move to Chip Ganassi Racing was fueled by a desire to lead a team at the highest level, and his emphasis on fostering a culture of continuous improvement has already started yielding positive results. What sets Arjun apart is his relentless focus on marginal gains and his commitment to developing young talent within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

Drinks exactly three cups of chai every day at precise intervals.
Has a whiteboard in his office filled with complex motorsport equations.
